steps: 1. Disable standalone **Tab Scoreboard**. Enable **Expanded Scoreboard (Live + End Screen)** and **Host Statistics**, then select **Page 2**.
2. Start Adventure SOLO with both melee and ranged weapons. Before fighting, **Melee Damage** and **Ranged Damage** after **Times Revived** must both show 0.
3. Kill enemies with only light/heavy melee attacks; confirm only Melee Damage rises. Then use only ranged attacks; confirm Ranged Damage rises without changing Melee Damage.
4. Check bot columns update as they fight and unrelated rows/sorting/page remain unchanged.
5. Finish and confirm both end-screen totals do not decrease. Start another mission and confirm both reset to 0 for everyone.
assertions: Damage is separated by melee versus ranged origin, correctly attributed on live/end screens and reset per mission, with no changes to unrelated scoreboard presentation.
Deal light/heavy melee then ranged damage: Melee and Ranged ledgers rise by the damage_dealt delta per classifier; bots credited; reset next mission.
